A1_S5_D1: ^Narrator: Despite being in a strange and unfamiliar place, you managed to fall asleep pretty quickly.
^Narrator: …It’d be a little more comfortable if Amelia didn’t keep rolling over and bumping you awake, but that’s alright.

^Mother: Which is why our home of Dusk is so successful, Noelle.
^Mother: You must always remember that we Tempests always stride forward. Leading our own to survival despite the harrowing, outside world.
